definitions.gloss: second term — the second of the academic terms in a Japanese school year; in a three-term system, roughly September to December
definitions.explanation: The second of the terms ({学期|がっき}) in a Japanese school year. In the most common three-term system used by Japanese elementary, junior high, and high schools, the second term runs from around early September (after the summer break) to late December (before the winter break). In two-term systems used by some universities, it corresponds to the fall/autumn semester.

examples.japanese: {二学期|にがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{二学期|にがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}{試験|しけん}→中間試験：06691_chuukanshiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧だ。
examples.english: The second-term midterm exams are next week.

examples.japanese: {二学期|にがっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧や⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the second term there are many events, such as sports days and culture festivals.

examples.japanese: {二学期|にがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|いち}{学期|がっき}→一学期：17203_ichigakki⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My grades for the second term went up compared to the first.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ ('two') and ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧ ('school term, semester'). Note the sound change: ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧ → {二学期|にがっき}, not ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くき.

USAGE:
- Refers to the second school term in the Japanese academic calendar.
- In a three-term system (⟦{三|さん}{学期|がっき}→三学期：30250_sangakki⟧⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧) — the standard for elementary, junior high, and most high schools — the second term runs roughly from September to December.
- In a two-term system ({二|に}{学期|がっき}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧), used by many universities and some schools, the second term is the fall/autumn semester, running from about October to February.
- Common context: school events like ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports day) and ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧ (culture festival) often fall in the second term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二学期|にがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the second term starts
- {二学期|にがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる: the second term ends
- {二学期|にがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: second-term grades
- {二学期|にがっき}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: the two-term system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一学期|いちがっき}→一学期：17203_ichigakki⟧: first term — April to July in the three-term system.
- ⟦{三学期|さんがっき}→三学期：30250_sangakki⟧: third term — January to March in the three-term system.
- ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧: school term, semester — the generic term for any one term.
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧: latter term/semester — often used in two-term university systems; overlaps with {二学期|にがっき} in that context.
